stories.title: Drugs buried at Creamfields site recovered in police searches
stories.summary: Police have dug up drugs buried in the grounds at Creamfields before a single festivalgoer has arrived. Cheshire Constabulary said the first week of pre-event searches at the Daresbury site turned up class A, B and C drugs hidden and buried in the ground. stories.title: Flintshire education services cause significant concern, Estyn inspectors find
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s education services cause significant concern, the education inspectorate for Wales has found. Estyn published its report today, Monday 24 August, following an inspection of the council’s education services in July. stories.title: Delays on both sides of A55 in Flintshire after collision near Pentre Halkyn
stories.summary: Long delays are continuing on the A55 through Flintshire almost an hour after a collision on the eastbound carriageway. Traffic Wales North and Mid said at 10.37 that lanes one and two were blocked between the Caerwys and Pentre Halkyn junctions, with traffic officers attending. stories.title: Section of Wepre Lane set to return to 30mph and new double yellow lines planned
stories.summary: Two changes to Wepre Lane in Connah’s Quay take effect on 4 September, one covering speed and one covering parking. stories.title: Disposable income in Flintshire rose 7 per cent in 2024, ONS figures show
stories.summary: Flintshire has the third highest disposable household income per head in Wales, according to figures published by the Office for National Statistics. The county recorded £23,426 per head in 2024, behind only Monmouthshire at £28,010 and the Vale of Glamorgan at £26,733.
